Who we are

The people who design a space should be the people who build it.

Established in 2020, OPRELL Interiors is a Dubai design & build studio where the designers, supervisors and trades on your project are all employed by one company.

No subcontracting chain. No hand-offs. A drawing office and a joinery workshop under one roof — so nothing is lost between the drawing and the build.

OPRELL Interiors · Dubai · Est. 2020
The OPRELL Model

Under one roof

Every trade in-house. Every project one contract, one programme, one responsible team.

01

Drawing Office

Concepts, layouts, materials and FF&E — resolved on paper before a single trade mobilises.

02

Joinery Workshop

Wardrobes, kitchens and custom furniture manufactured in our own workshop — our dimensions, our tolerances.

03

On-Site Trades

Civil, MEP, joinery and finishing crews employed by OPRELL — the same standards on every site.

04

Handover & Aftercare

Snag-free delivery, documented warranty and post-handover support from the team that built it.

The Workshop

Made in our own workshop

Most fit-out problems happen in the gap between a nice drawing and a subcontracted factory. We removed the gap — joinery, wardrobes and upholstered pieces come from our own line.

  • Custom wardrobes, kitchens & vanity joinery
  • Wall panelling, media walls & display furniture
  • Site-measured, workshop-made, our team installs
  • Shorter lead times, controlled quality, honest materials
  • Doors, frames, skirting & bespoke metalwork
  • Prototyped and QC-checked before anything reaches site

Our Mission, Vision & Approach

Est. 2020 · Dubai

Our Mission

Homes and workplaces designed and built by one accountable team — beautiful, practical and delivered on time.

Our Vision

To be the UAE's most trusted design & build studio — where nothing is lost between the drawing and the build.

APPROACH

A single design & build contract. Fixed programme and budget. In-house trades throughout — one line of responsibility, start to finish.

GOALS

Every handover on time, on budget and snag-free. Clients who come back — and bring their friends.

Our Core Values

01

DELIVERY

On time, to specification, to the standard promised. Handover is the moment of truth — and we plan backwards from it on day one.

02

CRAFT

Joinery from our own workshop, finishes by our own hands. The detail is the product — mitred edges, aligned shadow gaps, honest materials.

03

TRUST

Fixed budgets, weekly reporting, and clients who return project after project. Repeat relationships are the most honest measure of our work.

04

SAFETY

A safe site is a non-negotiable baseline — in lived-in villas, operating offices and every workspace in between.

05

INTEGRATION

Design, joinery, fit-out, landscape and management under one roof — no subcontracting chain, no gaps between trades.

06

CARE

We look after the space after handover — warranty follow-ups and support from the same people who built it.
